## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `41cd6dada272abba9af6448c2ad1586b0667add0`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `.changeset/36923-standalone-form-lookupautofill-refused.md`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupAutofill.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFormStamp.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/lookupAutofillStandaloneForm-36923.test.tsx`, `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx` + read, not reviewed: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/fieldWriteGate.ts` and the five layout files that call `gateFormFields`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupRecordReference.ts`, `ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts`, `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`, `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`, `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`, `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`

Inputs read: card #36923 (body and all 8 comments, ruling 7138010812, addendum 7145912427), PR #37090 (body, its one comment, 6 files, net diff `8aecf6d7..41cd6dad`), the 61 check-runs on the head (0 failed; every one is success or skipped; `Check Changeset` succeeded twice, the second run after the body edit at 22:15Z).

### ① Derived judgments

Every surface whose accept set, behaviour or type moves, and whether the PR names it:

- `readLookupAutofillTargets` (`@object-ui/fields`, through `export * from './widgets/lookupAutofill.js'`, `index.tsx:5534`). Narrows: it answered for any non-array object under `lookupAutofillTargets`; it now answers only for a map in the module-private `ISSUED_TARGET_STAMPS`. Type signature unchanged. Named right (banner, FROM, TO, fix).
- `withLookupAutofillTargets` (same export). Changes in the other direction: a field with pairs is now always returned as a stamped copy, with an empty map when `fields` is null or names no target; before it returned `def` itself. Named right in the TO line. Not named: the map is now `Object.freeze`d, and the return is no longer identical to `def` in the no-target case. See N3.
- `LOOKUP_AUTOFILL_TARGETS_KEY`. Value unchanged. A value under it is now data unless issued. Named right.
- `LookupField`, and so the registered `lookup` and `master_detail` widgets, and the published prop contract `FieldWidgetProps.onAutofill` (`widgets/types.ts:283-295`). This is the widest narrowing in the PR and it is beyond `readLookupAutofillTargets`: a pick used to fill whenever the host handed `onAutofill` and the field carried pairs; it now also needs an issued stamp. It reaches every host of the widget that is not one of the five `gateFormFields` callers, not only the `form` node. The changeset's prose names the standalone `form` node; the banner names the helper only; the prop's own JSDoc is unchanged. Named in part. See S1.
- The `form` renderer of `@object-ui/components`. No code change and no changeset entry for that package, which is right: nothing in it publishes differently. Its observable behaviour narrows through the widget (`field.field || field` at `form.tsx:4269` still hands the authored key down, `onAutofill` at `form.tsx:4350` is still handed). Named right in the prose.
- `stampRecordFormFields` and `gateFormFields` (`@object-ui/plugin-form`). Not in the package index; internal. Behaviour follows `withLookupAutofillTargets`. `recordFormStamp.ts` is a header-comment edit only. No changeset entry owed for `plugin-form`.
- Accept sets: none moves. `FormFieldSchema` stays a loose object and still accepts the key; `packages/spec` is untouched and `FieldSchema.lookupAutofill`'s describe (`field.zod.ts:2647`) already reads "the record form, and a line-item grid column over it".
- New observable output: one `console.warn` per field name. Named right.
- The census row text is accurate against the code.

S1 (should-fix) — the widget-level narrowing is not stated where a host author reads it. `FieldWidgetProps.onAutofill` (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts:283-289`, published) still gives the whole condition as "a single-value pick whose host owns no `onSelectRecord`" and "A lookup reached without it fills nothing". After this head a lookup reached with it, and without an issued stamp, also fills nothing. The BREAKING banner lists `readLookupAutofillTargets` alone, although a host that renders the widget with `onAutofill` is broken without ever calling that helper. Asked: one sentence on the prop's JSDoc naming the stamp, and one banner line naming `LookupField` with `onAutofill` as the narrowed surface. The fix line the banner already carries (stamp through `withLookupAutofillTargets`) is the right fix for that reader. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts:386` carries the same now-incomplete sentence; it is outside the diff and is named here for the same edit.

### ② Semver level

- Level `patch` on `@object-ui/fields`: right. AGENTS.md, Post-Task Checklist step 3: a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition. Only `fields` publishes a code change; `plugin-form` moves a comment and a test, the catalog example is a test.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: right. A published export and a published widget behaviour answer for less than before. Present line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset.
- `Metadata-protocol: none`: right. No key, accepted value or type is added, removed or refused at any validator, and the declared meaning of `lookupAutofill` (object field; record form and grid column) is unchanged. What stops is undeclared execution at a site the describe never named. The letter of `semantic` ("a changed meaning") was weighed: the key was reachable on a `form` node only through the renderer's `field.field || field` fallback, never through a declaration, and ruling 7138010812 treats it as undeclared there. Measured reach is 0.
- BREAKING banner with FROM, TO and the fix: present and accurate for the helper. Its coverage gap is S1.
- ADR-0087 disposition. Exactly one marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. Read against `CATEGORIES` and the ADR's vocabulary paragraph (`docs/adr/0087-…md:758-786`):
  - `runtime-interface-only`: closed on the facts. The resolver reads `export interface|type|class|enum` only (`check-adr-0087-registration.mjs:2937`); `readLookupAutofillTargets` is a function. The dev's reading is correct.
  - `runtime-export-retired`: closed. The export is present at HEAD.
  - `type-surface-only`: closed. Nothing narrows off `any`; the declared type is unchanged.
  - `unpublished`, `already-registered`: closed. The package publishes; no ledger id covers this.
  - `registered`: not the right answer here. It needs an id new in this diff under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`. The ledger describes the declared protocol, and with `Metadata-protocol: none` standing there is no declared surface for an entry to name. The dev's second reason (outside the card's fence) is a fence argument, not the deciding one; the deciding one is that the kind is `none`.
  - `no-migration-prescription`: the right marker of the closed set, and the gate admits it because the kind is `none` (the outright refusal is keyed on `narrowed`). It is admitted on a detector miss, not on a fact: the category's own rule is that a body carrying a migration prescription cannot hold it, and this body carries FROM, TO and two `Fix:` sentences, written without an arrow or a framed table. That is the shape ADR-0087 records for changeset 15205 (`…md:1076-1086`) before D9 gave it a category. A behaviour narrowing of a published runtime function has no fact-based category today. See S2.
- `Skills-docs: none`: right in substance. `git grep -i lookupAutofill` over `skills/**` at the head: `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md:92-104` ("in the form and the line-item grid", taught as an object-field key), `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md:214` ("fills only the form and the grid"), and one eval pair in `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json:176-177`. None teaches the key on a standalone `form` node. `ui/skills/` does not exist at the head. `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx:282` already says "in the record form, and in a line-item grid column". See N2 for the reason text.

S2 (should-fix) — the marker's justification does not say what it rests on. It argues "the consumer is code calling it, not metadata an upgrade could rewrite", which is true, and stays silent on the body's own FROM, TO and `Fix:` lines, which are the thing the category's rule refuses. Asked: one sentence in the marker's why stating that the body carries a code-level prescription, that no fact-based category addresses a behaviour-narrowed runtime function (`runtime-interface-only` reads types, `runtime-export-retired` reads an absent export), and a follow-up card for that vocabulary gap, as 15205's marker did. The marker itself stays.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev flag, "the PR title has no `!`; no gate asks for one": confirmed, and it is not owed. The landing dogfood gate and `l1-face` read the title's `!` or the `(narrowing)` arm as alternatives; `check:adr-0087-registration` reads the changeset, where the banner and the arm declare the break. Adding `!` would make the squash subject agree with the banner and is the seat's choice; nothing here depends on it.
- Dev flag, the PR body still read `Clause-②: no`: closed. The body at this head reads `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs: none — …`.
- Deviation, `recordFormStamp.ts` outside the claimed file surface: accepted. Comment-only, and the old sentence ("its lookup copies as it always did") would be false at this head.
- Deviation, overlap-check missed before the first three pushes: process only; `git merge-tree origin/main 41cd6dad` is clean now and no file of the diff moved on main since the merge base.
- Deviation, ablations ran on the 7-case file at 6c1dfb34: stands as stated; the LookupField hunk changed once after that (`ac3310d1`, the warning's name source only). Passed to L1.
- Fence of the claim (no new public export from `components` or `fields`, no `packages/spec` edit): held. `ISSUED_TARGET_STAMPS` and `warnAutofillRefused` are module-private.
- Out-of-scope finding (the export now answers issued-only): closed by the narrowing declaration.
- `open_questions`: none in the newest report.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff holds no query, no id materialisation and no join.
- Escalated to L1, not judged here: the newest payload-bearing `os-dev-report` (7142196236) still reads `dogfood_battery: n/a`. The addendum 7145912427 opens "os-dev-report addendum …", which `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` does not match, so the landing gate will not read the battery it reports.

### ④ Design judgment

Against the ruling (7138010812) and the code:

- Refuse, not execute: held. `declaredPairs` keeps the old condition; `autofillPairs` is `declaredPairs` only when `readLookupAutofillTargets(fieldMeta)` answers, and both consumers (the pick fill at `LookupField.tsx:1329`, the opening fill at `:1361`) read `autofillPairs`. The lookup's own value is still set.
- The refusal sits in the widget, as the ruling's premise required: `form.tsx` cannot import from `fields` (`fields/package.json:33` depends on `components`), and no new export, prop or context was added.
- Fires only on standalone forms: in this repository, yes. `onAutofill` has one producer, `form.tsx`; the `form` node is built by `ObjectForm` (both arms), `ModalForm`, `DrawerForm`, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm`, and each passes `gateFormFields` output. `FormPage` draws its own widgets and hands no `onAutofill`, so it filled nothing before and warns nothing now. `GridField` hands `onSelectRecord`, which empties `declaredPairs` before the stamp is read. Outside the repository it fires on any host of the widget that does not stamp; that is S1.
- The ruling's caveat ("no stamp alone is not the test") is met by making the stamp complete: `withLookupAutofillTargets` returns early only when the field declares no pairs, so `restamp` stamps the entry and its inner `field` whenever either carries pairs, with an empty map when `objectFields` is absent or names no target. Pinned for `null`, `undefined`, a map without the targets, and `stampRecordFormFields([lookup], undefined)`.
- Stamp read: sound. Identity in a module-private `WeakSet`, the pattern `withRecordBeingEdited` already uses on main (`lookupRecordReference.ts:73,178`). The stamp survives the path: `restamp`, `applyFieldPermissions`, the layout spreads, `withUsedCurrencyCodes` are shallow; no `structuredClone`, JSON round-trip or deep clone sits in `plugin-form`, the form renderer or `SchemaRenderer`. Nothing parsed from a document can be a member, and the forged-key case is pinned.
- A legitimate author-written autofill wrongly refused: none found inside the repository. Pairs written on a record form's `customFields` member or section entry pass through the gate and are stamped. `ObjectForm.lookupAutofill-28245.test.tsx:633-637` asserts the fill in the sectioned, drawer, modal, tabbed and wizard layouts and `Test UI` is green at this head, so a lost stamp in any of them would now show as an empty target.
- Empty stamp and the currency rule: `currencyTargets` is undefined for an empty map, so `autofillCurrency`, `currencyFor` and the opening-fill wait behave exactly as an unstamped lookup did. No new unguarded copy is opened and none is closed inside a record form.
- Does it take a declared capability away, or make the spec's own refusal real: the second. The describe on main names the record form and the grid column; the standalone `form` node was never named, and the cross-currency rule the describe states could not hold there.

Attempts to break it, and what each found:

- Forged `lookupAutofillTargets` on a loose field: refused, pinned.
- Malformed or empty `lookupAutofill`: `declaredPairs?.length` is falsy, no fill and no warning, as before.
- `multiple` lookups and grid cells: unchanged, no warning.
- A record form with the schema still loading or no metadata source: empty stamp, copies as before.
- Warning repeated per render or per pick: no, a module `Set` keyed by field name; pinned across two picks. Two forms sharing a field name warn once between them.
- Two copies of `@object-ui/fields` in one page: see N1.
- Production leak of the warning: see N4.

N1 (nit) — the whole feature now rests on module identity. `@object-ui/fields` ships both `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.cjs`; if a page ever loads two instances, a stamp issued through one is no stamp to the `LookupField` of the other, and record-form autofill stops with only the development warning to say so. Before this head the stamp was plain data and could not fail that way. `withRecordBeingEdited` already carries the same exposure on main, so this is a recorded cost, not a new class.

N2 (nit) — the `Skills-docs:` reason greps the helper names (`readLookupAutofillTargets`, `lookupAutofillTargets`). The author-facing change is `lookupAutofill` on a `form` node, and the grep that shows the line true is the one in ② above. The skills' "the form" is looser than the docs' "the record form"; that wording is #36349's subject.

N3 (nit) — the stamped map is now frozen and the no-target return is a copy. Neither is in the TO line. No in-tree caller writes to the map or compares the return to its argument.

N4 (nit) — the production guard is `globalThis.process?.env?.NODE_ENV === 'production'`. The new test proves it under Node, where `process` exists. In a browser bundle with no `process` global, whose bundler does not rewrite that exact spelling, the comparison is false and the warning prints in production: one line per field name, carrying the field name only. Whether the console's Vite build rewrites it was not measured (read-only review). The spelling is the one `lookupRecordReference.ts:246` already ships; the same package documents the bundler-replaced `process.env.NODE_ENV` idiom at `resolveActionParams.ts:65-74`.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `47d5f6956ca2a1dcf113d75cc3e2d90bd02ced69`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `.changeset/36923-standalone-form-lookupautofill-refused.md`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/lookupAutofill.ts`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/types.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/recordFormStamp.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/lookupAutofillStandaloneForm-36923.test.tsx`, `ui/examples/schema-catalog/test/form-field-channel-census-12130.test.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts` + read, not reviewed: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx`, `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx`, `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md`

Delta review of the record at `41cd6dada272abba9af6448c2ad1586b0667add0` (PASS, S1 and S2 open). Inputs read: that record and the seat's L1 REWORK, the zone's finalized-head comment 7150635783, the PR body at this head, card #37136 (body, its one comment, timeline), the diffs `41cd6dad..47d5f695`, `952484e2..47d5f695` and `8aecf6d7..236c8044`, the files at this head, and the 61 check-runs on it (46 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed or running; `Check Changeset` success twice).

What the delta is: one merge commit `952484e2` (parents `41cd6dad` and `236c8044`, 37 commits of main) and one commit `47d5f695` touching three files (+14 −4): the changeset, `widgets/types.ts`, `plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts`.

The merge: its tree `71dc8d5e` equals `git merge-tree --write-tree 41cd6dad 236c8044`, so there is no hand resolution to read. The PR's net diff is byte-identical on both sides of the merge (`8aecf6d7..41cd6dad` against `236c8044..952484e2`, index lines apart). Main touched none of the PR's files in those 37 commits. In the packages the PR reads, main moved `fields/src/index.tsx` (a new export `resolveFormulaValueType` and its use in `FormulaCellRenderer`), `fields/src/formulaValueType.ts`, `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` and one test; none of them reads or hands `onAutofill`, `lookupAutofill` or the stamp. `export * from './widgets/lookupAutofill.js'` is still there (`index.tsx:5539`).

### ① Derived judgments

S1: closed. Read at this head:

- `FieldWidgetProps.onAutofill` (`widgets/types.ts:289-293`) now reads "A lookup reached with it fills only when the record form stamped the field (`withLookupAutofillTargets`, applied to every field the record form draws): a host that hands `onAutofill` without that stamp, such as a standalone `form` node, fills nothing either." That is the sentence asked for, and it is true to `LookupField.tsx:1252-1255`. The prop's type (`:299`) is unchanged.
- The changeset has a second BREAKING banner, placed first, naming `@object-ui/fields`, the `lookup` and `master_detail` widgets, and `LookupField` handed `onAutofill`, with FROM, TO and Fix.
- `plugin-grid/src/relationalMetaKeys.ts:386` now says the key is read "only when its host hands it an `onAutofill` writer and the record form stamped the field". The entry's `verdict` and `readers` are unchanged; only the `note` string moved.

The banner against the code:

- FROM ("a single-value pick filled the declared targets whenever the host handed `onAutofill` (and no `onSelectRecord`) and the field carried `lookupAutofill` pairs"): true. It is the `declaredPairs` condition, `!multiple && !onSelectRecord && props.onAutofill`, which was the whole gate before this PR.
